- **Trusts:** Establishing trusts can help reduce the taxable estate. Trusts can hold assets outside of your taxable estate, thereby reducing the amount subject to inheritance tax.

- **Gifts Before Death:** If possible, make gifts to beneficiaries before your death. This can reduce the size of your taxable estate.
